values.note: May-October: non-electric $26.25 weeknights, $31.50 Friday-Sunday and summer holidays; electric $33 and $38.50. November-December and March-April: non-electric $22, electric $27.50. A flat processing fee per reservation (amount not posted). 25% senior discount (60+) Monday-Thursday nights in peak season. Firefly quoted $22 and $27.50 for 2026-11-10; June 2027 shows no price yet.

fees.source: https://www.summitmetroparks.org/activities/camping/ (fee table) + https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/NimisilaReservoirMetroParkCampground (quote 2026-11-10, 1 night, 2 adults, 23-ft Class C), read 2026-10-31

values.note: 29 sites: 1-11 non-electric, 12-29 electric, 3 ADA; every site offered to a 23-ft Class C on Firefly, rated 41-58 ft, paved driveways.

sites.source: https://www.summitmetroparks.org/activities/camping/ ('Twenty-nine individual sites ... 18 sites have electricity. Three are ADA accessible') + https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/NimisilaReservoirMetroParkCampground ('Fits RVs up to 41-58 ft' per site), read 2026-10-31

hookups.source: https://www.summitmetroparks.org/activities/camping/ ('There are no showers or drinking water at the campground'); rules PDF: 'Bring your own water', read 2026-10-31

values.note: The faucet at the dump station is only for rinsing tanks. Generator-free campground.

facilities.source: https://www.summitmetroparks.org/activities/camping/ ('dump station, free of charge for registered campers'; 'no showers or drinking water') + rules PDF, read 2026-10-31

values.note: Online through Firefly Reservations or in person at the Metro Parks office, 975 Treaty Line Rd., Akron (330-867-5511). Maximum 10 consecutive nights in a 30-day period. Check-in 2 pm, checkout 11 am. Cancel 14+ days out for a full refund, 4-13 days 50%, 3 days or less none. Reserver must be 18+.

booking.source: https://www.summitmetroparks.org/activities/camping/ ('Reservations may only be made online and in person') + its 'Book a campsite' link to https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/NimisilaReservoirMetroParkCampground, read 2026-10-31

note: Summit Metro Parks. Wooded campground near the reservoir's eastern bank; no site sits on the water. Generator-free. No swimming in the reservoir; electric motors only. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 29 sites/18 electric, no water, dump, closed Jan-Feb. Changed: platform reserveamerica -> Firefly (operator); fees 33-38.50 -> 22-38.50 (off-season + non-electric, all sites fit); added 58-ft max, 10-night max, season Mar-Dec. Waterfront stays not waterfront.
